title: Headless main-quest chain: the Strip gate (the Securitron's credit check) and Ring-a-Ding-Ding (VMQTops 10 -> 80, Benny met, invited to the presidential suite, killed there, the Platinum Chip taken); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: Starts where boulder-city.actions.json ends: VMQ01 done, VMQTops at 10 (find Benny at the Tops). The player has 2000 caps for the Strip's credit check and Speech 60 for Benny's suite invitation.

actions.label: Strip gate locked before the check

actions.text: The Securitron greeter at the north gate: the player shows 2000 caps (the line for the player's sex is the one that passes). Its end script unlocks the gate and marks the player as cleared.

On the Strip: the player walks into the trigger by the gate where Victor first greets the player (VMQTops 5 only when VMQTops 10 is not shown; here it is). Then into the Tops' lobby trigger (VMQTops 10 again, Benny's package re-evaluated).
Benny on the casino floor: the player takes his invitation to the presidential suite (Speech 60). Its end script sets stage 20, gives the suite key and sends Benny up (bennygotopresidential).

The player rides up and steps out of the lift (the elevator trigger completes objective 20). Benny waits in the suite; the player kills him there (combat's end as a stand-in). His OnDeath block puts the Platinum Chip on him and sets stage 43.
The player loots Benny's body: everything he carries moves to the player, the chip's OnAdd block sets stage 80 and adds its note.
